metadata.llm_reason: Scale Value Inversion is a distinct micro-skill focused on reverse-mapping range values to domain values on linear scales. It differs from peer candidates: Domain Normalization (domain adjustment, initialization stage), Threshold Scale Value Lookup (threshold scales with invertExtent, different scale type), and Unknown Value Fallback (ordinal scale error handling). The candidate addresses a specific execution-stage need for linear scale inversion with clear constraints and cautions. Support evidence from D3 API confirms the capability exists and is documented.
